contentPattern.structure: vertical list with grouped headings + nested items + active indicator

suitableFor: product/download selector navigation shared across template pages
grouped hierarchical left-rail navigation with an active state
notSuitableFor: top-level global site navigation (use header block)
flat single-level menus that fit default content

usage.note: Authored inline on the /try signup page. For the 25 /try/download/* pages the nav lives in a single shared fragment at /fragments/try/download/sidebar-nav, which each page references; the two-column grid is handled in styles.css for both the inline and fragment-injected shapes.
